m: अपि or sometimes पि (see पि-दृभ्, पि-धा, पि-नह्), expresses placing near or over, uniting to, annexing, reaching to, proximity, &c.
अपि [cf. Gk. ἐπί; Zend api; Germ. and Eng. prefix be]
in later Sanskṛt its place seems frequently supplied by अभि.
(As a separable adv.) and, also, moreover, besides, assuredly, surely
suppose that, perhaps, Jātakam.
अपि अपि or अपि-च, as well as
न वापि or न अपिवा or न नचापि, neither, nor, चापि, (and at the beginning of a sentence) अपि-च, moreover.
अपि is often used to express emphasis, in the sense of even, also, very
e.g. अन्यद् अपि, also another, something more
अद्यापि, this very day, even now
तथापि, even thus, notwithstanding
यद्य् अपि, even if, although
यद्यपि तथापि, although, nevertheless
न कदाचिद् अपि, never at any time: sometimes in the sense of but, only, at least, e.g. मुहूर्तम् अपि, only a moment.
अपि may be affixed to an interrogative to make it indefinite, e.g. को ऽपि, any one
कुत्रापि, anywhere.
अपि imparts to numerals the notion of totality, e.g. चतुर्णाम् अपि वर्णानाम्, of all the four castes.
अपि may be interrogative at the beginning of a sentence.
अपि may strengthen the original force of the Potential, or may soften the Imperative, like the English ‘be pleased to’;
sometimes it is a mere expletive.
अपि तु but, but yet.
(अपि-अपि), as well-as, ib.
a: अपि — ind. (Sometimes with the अ dropped according to the opinion of Bhāguri; वष्टि भागुरिरल्लोपमवाप्योरुपसर्गयोः; पिधा, पिधान &c.) 1 (Used with roots and nouns in the sense of) Placing near or over, taking towards, uniting with; reaching or going up to, proximity, nearness &c. [Cf. Gr. epi, Zend api, Germ. and Eng. be]. (Note. अपि, as a prefix to roots, occurs mostly in Veda, its place being taken by अभि in classical literature). --2 (As a separable adverb or conjunction) And, also, too, moreover, besides, in addition, having a cumulative force (समुच्चय); अस्ति मे सोदरस्नेहोप्येतेषु; Ś. 1 on one's part, in one's turn; विष्णुशर्मणापि राजपुत्राः पाटिताः Pt. 1; राजापि मुनिवाक्यमंगीकृत्यातिष्ठत् Dk. 2; अपि -अपि or अपि च as well as, and also; अपि स्तुहि, अपि सिंच P. I. 4. 96 Sk., न नापि-न चैव, न वापि, नापि वा न चापि neither-nor; न वापि काव्यं नवमित्यवद्यं M. 1. 2 nor; वापि or; अल्पोप्येवं महान् वापि Ms. 3. 53 whether small or great. --3 It is often used to express emphasis in the sense of ‘too’, ‘even’ ‘very’; विधुरपि विधियोगाद् ग्रस्यते राहणासौ H. 1 the very moon; यूयमप्यनेन कर्मणा परिश्रांताः Ś. 1 even you, you also; अन्यदपि also another; अद्यापि even, yet, still, even now; इदानीमपि even now; मुहूर्तमपि even for a moment, for one moment at least; नाद्यापि not yet; यद्यपि though, although, even if; तथापि still, nevertheless, notwithstanding, yet; sometimes यद्यपि is understood, तथापि only being used; as in Ki. 1. 28. --4 Though (oft. translateable by ‘even’, ‘even if’); सरसिजमनुविद्धं शैवलेनापि रम्यं Ś. 1. 20 though overspread &c.; इयमधिकमनोज्ञा वल्कलेनापि तन्वी ibid. though in her bark dress; बलवदपि शिक्षितानाम् 1. 2 though ever so learned. In this sense अपि is most frequently used by writers to show real or imaginary opposition (विरोध); कृष्णमपि असुदर्शनं, पुष्पवत्यपि पवित्रा &c. --5 But, however. --6 Used at the beginning of sentences अपि introduces a question; अपि सन्निहितोऽत्र कुलपतिः Ś. 1; अपि क्रियार्थं सुलभं समित्कुशं… अपि स्वशक्त्या तपसि प्रवर्तसे Ku. 5. 33, 34, 35; अप्यग्रणीर्मंत्रकृतामृषीणां कुशाग्रबुद्धे कुशली गुरुस्ते R. 5. 4. --7 Hope, expectation (usually with the potential mood); कृतं रामसदृशं कर्म . अपि जीवेत्स ब्राह्मणशेशुः U. 2. I hope the Brāhmaṇa boy comes to life. Note-In this sense अपि is frequently used with नाम and has the sense of (a) ‘is it likely’, ‘may it be’; (b) ‘perhaps’, ‘in all probability’ or (c) ‘would that’, ‘I wish or hope’ that’; अपि नाम कुलपतोरियमसवर्णक्षेत्रसंभवा स्यात् Ś. 1; Ś. 7; तदपि नाम मनागवतीर्णोसि रतिरमणबाणगोचरं Māl. 1 perhaps, in all probability; अपि नाम तयोः कल्याणिनोः अभिमतः पाणिग्रहः स्यात् ibid.; अपि नाम रामभद्रः पुनरपीदं वनमलंकुर्यात् U. 2; ‘is it likely’, ‘I wish’; यथा वनज्योत्स्नानुरूपेण पादपेन संगता अपि नाम एवमहमप्यात्मनोऽनुरूपं वरं लभेयेति Ś. 1 would that; अपि नामाहं पुरूरवा भवेयं V. 2 I wish I were P. --8 Affixed to interrogative words अपि makes the sense indefinite, ‘any’, ‘some’; कोपि some one; किमपि something; कुत्रापि somewhere; कदापि at any time; कथमपि any how &c. केऽपि एते प्रवयसः त्वां दिदृक्षवः U. 4 some people. It may often be translated by ‘unknown’, ‘indescribable,’ ‘inexpressible’ (अनिर्वाच्य); व्यतिषजति पदार्थानांतरः कोपि हेतुः U. 6. 12; तत्तस्य किमपि द्रव्यं यो हि यस्य प्रियो जनः 2. 19; Mu. 3. 22; K. 143; कोपि महिमा स्यात् U. 6, 6. 11, 7. 12; Māl. 1. 26; R. 1. 46. --9 After words expressing number अपि has the sense of ‘totality’, ‘all’; चतुर्णामपि वर्णानां of all the 4 castes; सर्वैरपि राज्ञां प्रयोजनं Pt. 1. --10 It sometimes expresses ‘doubt’ or ‘uncertainty,’ ‘fear’ (शंका); अपि चोरो भवेत् G. M. there is perhaps a thief. --11 (with pot. mood) It has the sense of संभावना ‘possibility’, ‘supposition’; P. I. 4. 96; III. 3. 154; अपि स्तुयाद्विष्णुं, अपि स्तुयाद्राजानं, अपि गिरिं शिरसा भिंद्यात् Sk.; सोयमपि सिंचेत्सहस्रं द्राक्षाणां क्षणेनैकेन Dk. 127. --12 Contempt, censure, or reproof; P. I. 4. 96, III. 3. 142; धिग्देवदत्तमपि स्तुयाद्वृषलं; धिग्जाल्मं देवदत्तमपि सिंचेत् पलांडुं; अपि जायां त्यजसि जातु गणिकामाधत्से गर्हितमेतत् Sk. shame to, &c. or fie upon, Devadatta &c. --13 It is also used with the Imperative mood to mark ‘indifference on the part of the speaker’, where he permits another to do as he likes, (अन्ववसर्ग or कामचारानुज्ञा, the imperative being softened;) अपि स्तुहि Sk. you may praise (if you like); अपि स्तुह्यपि सेधास्मांस्तथ्यमुक्तं नराशन Bk. 8. 92. --14 अपि is sometimes used as a particle of exclamation, --15 Rarely in the sense of ‘therefore,’ ‘hence’ (अत एव). --16 Used as a separable preposition with gen. it is said to express the sense of a word understood (पदार्थ), and is treated as a कर्मप्रवचनीय P. I. 4. 96; the example usually given is सर्पिषोपि स्यात् where some word like बिंदुरपि ‘a drop,’ ‘a little’ &c. has to be understood, ‘there may perhaps be a drop of ghee,’ ‘I presume there may be at least a drop’ &c. अपि संभावनाप्रश्नशंकागर्हासमुच्चये . तथायुक्तपदार्थेषु कामचारक्रियासु च .. Viśva.; अपिः पदार्थसंभावनान्ववसर्गगर्हासमुच्चयेषु P. I. 4. 96. G. M. adds the senses of आशिस् ‘blessing’ (भद्रमपि), मृति ‘death’ (मरणमपि) and भूषा ‘decoration’ (अपि न ह्यति हारं).

m: अपि-भाग mfn. having part in, sharing in ŚBr.
a: अपिभाग — a. Ved. Sharing or partaking in, having a share.

m: अपि-√ भू to be in, AV.; to have part in, RV.; AitBr.
अपि-√ धा Ved. to place upon or into, put to, give; chiefly Ved. to shut, close, cover, conceal (in later texts more usually पि-√ धा, q.v.)
a: अपिधा — {c3c} U. To shut, close, cover, conceal.

m: अपि-धानी f. a cover, Āp. (cf. पि-धान.)

s: klI, (api + DA + BAve lyuw .) AcCAdanaM । antardDAnaM । ityamaraH ॥ (AvaraRaM । “dvAre purasyodGawitApiDAne” । iti kumArasamBave । “SilApiDAnA kAkutsTa durgaM cAsyAH praveSanaM” । iti rAmAyaRe .)
v: na॰ api + DA--lyuw । 1 AcCAdane । karaRe lyuw । 2 tatsAGane tri॰ । “amftApiDAnamasi svAheti” BojanAnta jalapAnamantraH “rADyamAnasyOdanasya dyOrapiDAnamiti” aTa॰ 11, 3, 1 । sADane AcCAdanatvopacArAt sAmAnADikaraRyam । aperato vA lope piDAnamapyatra “pfTivI te pAtraM dyOH piDAnamiti” SrAdDamantraH “tasya taddvAraM yadamAvAsyA candramA evadvArapiDAnaH” Sata॰ brA॰ ।
m: अपि-धान n. placing upon covering, KātyŚr.
a cover, a cloth for covering, RV. &c.
a lid, BhP.
a bar, Kum.
a: अपिधानं, --पिधानं — 1 Covering, concealing, concealment. --2 A cover, lid, covering (fig. also); अमृतापिधानमसि स्वाहा; नैकजलदच्छत्रापिधानं जगत् Mk. 5. 24; a cloth for covering.

m: अपि-धान—वत् (अपिधान-) mfn. ‘having a cover’, concealed, RV. v, 29, 12.
अपि-√ धाव् to run into, Vait.
अपि-√ धम् to blow upon, Kauś.

v: pu॰ apiDIyate tfptiparyyantaM dIyate api + DA--ki । 1 tfptiparyantadatte । “priyA~ apiDI~ vanizIzwa” f॰ 1, 127, 7, “apaDIn tfptiparyyantaM dattAniti” BA॰ ।
m: अपि-धि m. ‘that which is placed upon the fire’, a gift to Agni, RV. i, 127, 7.
a: अपिधिः — f. Concealment, covering --धिः What is given to another's entire satisfaction तृप्तिपर्यंतदत्त.

m: अपि-√ घस् to eat off or away (perf. 3. pl. -जक्षुः), ŚBr.; (aor. Ā. 3. sg. -ग्ध [fr. घ्-स्-त], which by, Sāy. is derived fr. √ हन्), RV. i, 158, 5.
अ-पिण्ड mfn. without funeral balls.
अ-पिशाचधीत mfn. (prob. right reading) not drunk or sucked by Piśācas, Hir. i, 25, 1.
अपि-√ शॄ P. to break off, AV.; Ā. id., ŚBr. : Pass. -शीर्यते, to break, PBr.
अपि-शीर्ण mfn. broken, AV. iv, 3, 6.

v: pu॰ apiSalate api + Sala--ac । 1 muniBede tasyApatyam iY । ApiSaliH । SAbdikaBede । “indraScandraH kASakftsnApiSalI SAkawAyanaH । pARinyamarajEnendrAjayantyazwAdiSAbdikA” ka॰ ka॰ “supyApiSaleH” iti pA॰ ।
m: अपिशल m. N. of a man
the descendants of Apiśala. See आपिशलि.
a: अपिशलः — N. of a man; a grammarian; (pl.) his descendants.

m: अपि-शर्वर mfn. ‘contiguous to the night’, being at the beginning or end of the night, AitBr.
अपि-शर्वर (अम्), n. the time early in the morning, RV.
a: अपिशर्वर — a. Ved. Close to the night, being at the beginning (or end) of the night. --रं Early or untimely morning, evening (or morning) time (प्रदोषमुखं).

v: tri॰ apiH prAdurBAve avyayI॰ bA॰ ac samA॰ । 1 SarvvarImuKasamaye pradozakAle, “samidDamapiSarvare” iti f॰ 3, 9, 7, । “apiSarvare SarvarImuKe” iti BA॰ ।

m: अपि-शस् f. (only used in abl. -शसस्) slitting, ripping up, MaitrS.; AitBr.
a: अपिशस् — a. Ripping up.

m: अ-पिशुन mfn. unmalicious, upright, honest.
अपि-बद्ध mfn. fastened, R. iii, 68, 42.
अपि-√ बन्ध् Ā. to fasten upon, put on (a wreath), ĀśvGṛ.

s: tri, (na picCilaH naYsamAsaH .) pEcCilyABAvaviSizwaH । picCilatASUnyaH । yaTA । “pramehiRo yadA mUtramanAvilamapicCilaM” । iti mADavakaraH ॥ (parizkftaH । amalinaH । nirmalaH । gAQaH .)
v: tri॰ na॰ ta॰ । 1 picCilaviroDini gAQe 2 apaNkile ca । “pramehiRo yadA mUtramanAvilamapicCilamiti” nidA॰ ।
m: अ-पिच्छिल mfn. clear, free from sediment or soil.
a: अपिच्छिल — a. 1 Not muddy, clear, free from sediment. --2 Deep.

m: अपि-√ दह् -दहति (impf. -अदहत्) to touch with fire, to singe, TS.; Kāṭh.
अपि-√ दो (1. sg. -द्यामि) to cut off, AV. iv, 37, 3.
अपि—द्रष्टृ m. a superintendent, ŚāṅkhŚr., Sch.
अपि-√ 1. गा Ved. to enter, get into, mingle with, RV. vii, 21, 5, &c.

s: tri, (api + gF + karmmaRi ktaH .) stutaM । varRitaM । ityamaraH ॥
v: tri॰ api + gF--kta । 1 kaTite 2 varRRite 3 stute ca ।
m: अपि-गीर्ण mfn. praised, L.
a: अपिगीर्ण — a. 1 Praised, celebrated. --2 Told, described.

m: अपि-√ गम् Ved. to go into, enter, approach, join, [aor. Subj. 3. pl. अपिग्मन्, RV. v, 33, 10] RV. &c.; to approach a woman, RV. i, 179, 1.

v: tri॰ api + graha--vede--kyap loke Ryat । 1 pratigrAhye ।
m: 1. अपि-गृह्य ind.p. closing the mouth, TS.
2. अपि-गृह्य [Ved. Pāṇ. iii, 1, 118] or अपि-ग्राह्य [ib. Comm.], अम्, n. impers. (with abl.) the mouth to be closed before (a bad smell, &c.)
अपि-√ ग्रह् (with or without मुखम्, नासिके, &c.), to close (the mouth, nose, &c.), ŚBr.; AitBr.; ChUp.
अपि-गुण mfn. excellent, MBh. xii, 2677.
अपि-√ हन् (3. pl. घ्नन्ति) to remove or suppress (pregnancy, सूतुम्), TS.

v: tri॰ api + DA--kta । 1 Avfte “tucCenABurapihita” iti SrutiH । atolope pihito'pyatra “BujaNgapihitadvAramiti” raGuH ।
m: अपि-हित mfn. put to, placed into, RV.
shut, covered, concealed, RV. &c. (cf. पि-हित)
अपि-हित &c. See अपि-√ ध.
a: अपिहित --पिहित — p. p. 1 Shut, closed, covered, concealed (fig. also); बाष्पापिहेत covered with tears. --2 Not concealed, plain, clear; अर्थो गिरामपिहितः पिहितश्च किंचित्, सत्यं चकास्ति मरहदृवधूस्तनाभः Subhāṣ.

m: अपि-हिति f. a bar, MaitrS.; PBr.
अपि-√ ह्नु (3. du. अपि ह्नुतः) to refuse, RV. viii, 31, 7.
अपि-√ ह्वे (1. sg. Ā. -हुवे) to call addition to (or besides), RV. x, 19, 4.

v: tri॰ api + java--kvip--UW । 1 prerake । “uzasAnaktA jagatAmapIjuvA” f॰ 2, 31, 5 । “apijuvA prerayitrya” iti vede uvaN mA॰ ।

tri॰ api apsu jAyate jana--qa aluksamA॰ vede apSabdasyEkatvam । 1 jyEzWemAsi tasya jalakrIqAratisADanatvAttaTAtvam । “prasavAya svAhApijAya svAhe ti” yaju॰ 18, 28 । “apsu jAyate ityapijaH jalakrIqAratatvAjajyEzWe iti” vedadIpaH ।
m: अपि-ज m. born after or in addition to (N. of Prajāpati and other divinities), VS.
a: अपिज — a. Born after or again, epithet of several deities. --जः [अपि अप्सु जायते, अलुक् वेदे अप्शब्दस्यैकवचनत्वमपि] N. of the month ofJyeṣṭha (जलक्रीडारतिसाधनत्वात्तथात्वं).

v: avya॰ kakze viBaktyarTe avyayI॰ । 1 kakzapradeSe ityarTe “grIvAyAM badDo apikakza Asani” f॰ 4, 40, 4 ।
m: अपि-कक्ष m. the region of the arm-pits and shoulder-blades (especially in animals), RV. iv, 40, 4; x, 134, 7; Lāṭy.
N. of a man and m. pl. his descendants.
a: अपिकक्षः — Ved. The region of the arm-pits and shoulder-blades, especially in animals. --क्षं ind. In the armpit.

v: tri॰ apikakzaM sanDAnam yat । 1 kakzapradeSena saMDAnaBUte pravargyavidyArUpe rahasye । “tvAzwraM yaddasrAvare'pikakzye vAm” f॰ 1, 117 22 । “apikakzyaM Cinnasya yajYaSirasaH kakzapradeSena saMDAnaBUtaM pravargyavidyAKyaM rahasyamiti” BA॰ ।
m: अपि-कक्ष्य (5) mfn. connected with the region of the arm-pits, RV. i, 117, 22.
a: अपिकक्ष्य — a. Belonging to this region (Sāy. on Rv. 1. 117. 22 says ˚क्ष्यं छिन्नस्य यज्ञशिरसः कक्षप्रदेशेन संधानभूतं प्रवर्ग्यविद्याख्यं रहस्यं).

v: na॰ apigataH karRam atyA॰ sa॰ । 1 samIpe । 2 tadvarttini tri॰ । “nu te apikarRRa AGfRe f॰ 6, 48, 16, “apikarRRe karRRasamIpagate samIpe sTitaH iti BA॰ ।
m: अपि-कर्ण n. the region of the ears, RV. vi, 48, 16.
a: अपिकर्णं — The region of the ears; near (समीप) Rv. 6. 48. 16.

m: अपि-√ 1. कृ to bring into order, arrange, prepare, TS.; TBr.; PBr.
अपि-√ 2. कृत् (1. sg. -कृन्तामि fut. 1. sg. -कर्त्स्यामि) to cut off, VS.; AV.; TS.; ŚBr.
अपि-√ क्षै Caus. -क्षापयति, to consume by fire, AV. xii, 5, 44 and 51.
अपि-मन्त्र mfn. giving an explanation or an account of Kāṭh.
अपि-√ मृष् Ā. -म्रिष्यते (1. sg. -मृष्ये; aor. Subj. 2. sg. -मृष्ठास्) to forget, neglect, RV.
अपि-नाम (in the beginning of a phrase), perhaps, in all probability, I wish that, Mṛcch.; Śāk. &c.
अपि-√ नी to lead towards or to, bring to a state or condition, TS.; ŚBr.; AitBr.
अपि—नद्धाक्ष mfn. one who has the eyes covered, hoodwinked, MaitrS.

s: tri, (api + nah + karmmaRi ktaH, asya vAlope pinadDaYca .) parihitavastrAdi । tatpaparyyAyaH । AmuktaH 2 pratimuktaH 3 pinadDaH 4 । ityamaraH ॥
v: tri॰ api + naha--kta । 1 parihite, atovAlope pinadDaSca tatrArTe ।
m: अपि-नद्ध mfn. closed, concealed, RV. x, 68, 8; ŚBr. (cf. पि-नद्ध.)

k.v: आमुक्तः प्रतिमुक्तश्च पिनद्धश्चापिनद्धवत्. संनद्धो वर्मितः सज्जो दंशितो व्युढकङ्कटः॥

m: अपि-√ नह् to tie on, fasten (usually पि-√ नह्, q.v.); to tie up, close, stop up (Ved.; later on पि-√ नह्, q.v.)
अपि-नेतृ ता, m. one who leads towards (gen.), ŚBr.
अ-पिपास mfn. free from thirst or desire, ŚBr. xiv; ChUp.
अपि-√ पथ् Caus. -पाथयति, to lead upon a path (acc.), KauṣBr.; ŚāṅkhŚr.
अपि-√ पद् to go in, enter, ŚBr.
अपि-पक्ष m. the region or direction to the side, TS.
अपि-√ पृच् (aor. 3. sg. अप्राग् अपि) to mix with (loc.), AV. x, 4, 26; (-पृञ्चन्ति, AV. v, 2, 3, according to BR. a mistake for -वृञ्जन्ति.)

v: tri॰ api + pra + ana--ac striyAM gO॰ NIz । 1 sarvvadA cezwamAne “yajatrA apiprARI ca sadanI ca BUyA” iti f॰ । 1, 186, 11 । “apiprARI sarvvadA cezwayitrIti” BA॰ ।
m: अपि-प्राण mf(ई)n. uttered or produced with every breath, RV. i, 186, 11.
a: अपिप्राण — a. (णी f.) Always animating or vivifying (सर्वदाचेष्टमान).

m: अपि-रिप्त mfn. (√ रिप्), ‘smeared over’ i.e. grown blind, RV. i, 118, 7; viii, 5, 23.
अपि-√ रुह् अपि-रोहति, to grow together, grow whole again, TS.
अपि-सं-गृभाय Nom. P. (Imper. 2. sg. -गृभाय) to assume, RV. x, 44, 4.
अपि-√ सृ to flow upon, ŚBr.; TBr.
अपि-√ सृज् P. to place to or upon, TS.; ŚBr. : P. and Ā. to add to, mingle to, Lāṭy.
अपि-√ सिच् to sprinkle with, L.
अपि—सोमपीथ mfn. partaking of Soma drink, ŚāṅkhBr.

v: strI Apa itogatA yasyAH vede na jaS । 1 jalarahitAyAM nadyAm “apitaH pinvataM Diya” f॰ 7, 82, 3 “apitojalarahitA nadIriti” BA॰ “asya made jaritamindrojinvadajuvo'pinvadapita” iti tadDftA SrutiH ।
m: 1. अ-पित् mfn. (√ पि), not swelling, dry, RV. vii, 82, 3.
2. अ-पित् mfn. (in Gr.) not having the इत् or Anu-bandha प्, Pāṇ.
a: अपित् — a. [आपः इतो गता यस्य वेदे न जष्] 1 Dry, waterless, as a river. --2 Not having the इत् or अनुबंध प्.

m: अ-पितृ ता, m. not a father, ŚBr. xiv.
अ-पितृ—देवत्य (अ-पितृ-) mfn. not having the Manes as deities, ŚBr.
अ-पितृक mfn. not ancestral or paternal, uninherited
fatherless, Āp.
a: अपितृक — a. 1 Fatherless. --2 Not ancestral or paternal, not inherited (अपैतृक also in this sense).

m: अ-पित्र्य mfn. not inherited, not ancestral or paternal, Mn. ix, 205.
a: अपित्र्य — a. Not ancestral.

s: vya, (api + tu .) yadyarTaM । yadyapi । iti trikARqaSezaH ॥
v: avya॰ api + tu + dva॰ । 1 yadyarTe trikA॰ । 2 kintu ityarTe BUriprayogaH ।
na॰ apitvarate'smE api + tvara--bA॰ qa । 1 BAge BAgino hi viBaktaDanAdyAdAnAya tvarante iti tasya taTAtvam । “tasyAmapitvamIzA te” iti Sata॰ brA॰ ।
m: अपि-त्व n. having part, share, AV.; ŚBr. (cf. अप-पित्व.)
a: अपित्वं — Ved. [अपित्वरते अस्मै, त्वर् बा˚ड] A part, portion, share.

v: tri॰ apitvaM BAgo'syAsti ini striyAM NIp । 1 BAgavati saBAge । “tasmin devatA apitvinyomanyante” iti Sata॰ brA॰ ।
m: अपि-त्विन् mfn. having part, sharing, ŚBr.
a: अपित्विन् — a. Having a share.

m: अपिवान्य-वत्सा = अभिवान्या, q.v., Kauś.
अपि-वाप m. ‘scattering upon’, N. of particular Puroḍāśa, TBr.
अपि-√ 2. वप् (1. sg. -वपामि) to scatter upon, AV.; ŚBr.; TBr.
अपि-वत् mf(वती)n. See अपि-√ वत्.

अपि-√ वत् (Opt. cl. 1. pl. -वतेम; pr. p. -वतत्) to understand, comprehend, RV. vii, 3, 10; 60, 6 : Caus. (Imper. 2. sg. -वातय; pr.p. -वातयत्; aor. 3. pl. -अवीवतन्, RV. x, 13, 5) to cause to understand, make intelligible to (with or without dat.), RV.; (1. pl. -वातयामसि) to excite, awaken, RV. i, 128, 2.
अपि-वती (scil. वाच्) f. of a conjecturable adj. अपिवत्य, intelligible, TBr. [‘containing the word अपि or what is meant by अपि’, Comm. & BR.]
अपि-√ 1. वृ (perf. Ā. -वव्रे) to conceal, RV. iii, 38, 8.
अपि-√ वृज् (3. pl. -वृञ्जन्ति; aor. 3. pl. अवृजन्न् अपि, RV. x, 48, 3) ‘to turn to’, procure to, bestow upon (dat. or loc.), RV.
अपि-√ वृत् Caus. (impf. 2. sg. -अवर्तयस्) to throw into (acc.), RV. i, 121, 13.
अपि-√ व्रश्च् (perf. Imper. 2. du. -ववृक्तम्, RV. vi, 62, 10) to strike off, cut off, RV.; AV.

v: tri॰ apiH saMsargesaMsfzwaM vrataM, karmma, BojanaM vAparaya । 1 dAyAdyenAviBakte 2 saMsfzwaDane 3 gotraje 4 saMsfzwaBojane ca । “apivratAScAnvAraBante yajamAnamiti” kA॰ 8, 6, 36 । “apivratAsta ucyante yezAM yajamAnavrate apitvamasti dayAdyenAviBaktA iti” pitfBUtiH “apivratA gotrajA iti karkaBA॰ “apiH saMsargesaMsfzwaM vrataM karmmayezAmiti apivratA aviBaktA dAyAdAH tehyekenApi kfzyAdi karmma kftaM sarva upajIvantIti harisvAmI, “vrataM BojanaM yajamAnena saha prAptaBojanAH banDuvargAH” iti mADavaH ।
m: अपि-व्रत mfn. sharing in the same religious acts, related by blood, ŚBr.; KātyŚr.
a: अपिव्रत — a. Sharing in the same religious acts or other works; connected by blood; अपिव्रताश्चान्वारभंते यजमानं Kāty. (संसृष्टं साधारणकर्म येषां ते अपिव्रताः अविभक्ता दायादाः, ते हि एकेनापि कृष्यादिकर्म कृतं सर्वे उपजीवंति Com.).

m: अपि-√ व्ये (1. pl. P. -व्ययूमसि) to cover, AV. i, 27, 1.
अपि-√ याच् Caus. -याचयते, to despise, refuse (?), AV. xii, 4, 38.
अपि-यत् mfn. entering the other world, dying, RV. i, 162, 20
dissolving, disappearing, BhP.
अपि-ष्ठा (√ स्था) to stand (too) near, stand in any one's way, AV. iii, 13, 4 and v, 13, 5.
अपि-ष्ठित mfn. approached, RV. i, 145, 4.
अपि-ष्टुत mfn. (√ स्तु), praised, L.
